item.title: Xbox Requires Four-Day Office Return From 2027
item.description: Xbox will require staff within 50 miles of Studio D to work in‑office four days a week starting Feb 1 2027, tightening Microsoft’s hybrid policy.

item.title: Xbox App on Hisense & VIDAA TVs – Game Pass Goes Console-Free
item.description: Microsoft brings the Xbox app to Hisense and other VIDAA‑OS TVs, letting Game Pass subscribers stream games without a console using an Xbox controller.

item.title: Microsoft Xbox Cuts 1600 Jobs
item.description: Microsoft lays off 1600 Xbox workers, sheds four studios, focusing on big games and AI investments
